profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary:
Application Development using Java technologies and frameworks like Spring, Spring Data, Hibernate, JPA, JMS, Bean Validation API, JDBC, SOAP, REST Web services, CXF, Servlets, JSP, JSF, and others. JMX using Jolokia and distributed maps with Hazelcast.

Experience with servers like WAS, JBoss, Glassfish. Databases like Oracle, MySQL, Sybase, SQLServer, MongoDB. 

Using dev/testing tools like JReports, soapUI, Postman, Eclipse, STS, Rational Application Developer, IntelliJ. 

Templates using Mustache, ERBs, HAML. 

AWS cloud technologies: Lambdas (Java and NodeJS). Caching using Elasticache (Redis). EC2, ECS. Docker. Implemented search solution using ElasticSearch (OpenSearch).

Script development with Ruby and Python. Infrastructure provisioning using Terraform.

Continuous Integration and Delivery, Agile methodologies. Tools like Jira, Bamboo, SVN, Git, Jenkins, Sonar reports, Unit testing (TDD) JUnit, PowerMock, Mockito. Maven/Ant.

Front end development with Javascript technologies like Angular for UI, VueJS, NodeJS + Express for web services, Electron, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS, JSON, Ajax, XML.
